caseMeaning.distinctTokens: Logout must leave no authenticated legacy fallback after revoking scoped.
caseMeaning.sameToken: Validate legacy before deleting chosen token; expire both names and revoke the shared token exactly once.

tests.network: Fake in-memory handler/AuthStore and CookieJar only; no HTTP, real login, or browser.

behavior.order: Read chosen own session; validate and save incoming legacy token against own AUTH_MGR before any deletion.
behavior.revocation: Ordered dedup of chosen and validated own legacy token; no copied/shared stores or foreign deletion.
behavior.expiration: Always expire actual HTTP-port scoped cookie; expire legacy only when validated in own store.
behavior.preserved: Login migration, scoped priority, no legacy downgrade, cookie flags, internal worker HTTP namespace, WS auth and startup routes remain unchanged.

scope: IT-only existing two source paths, new followup sibling proof. No service/process/browser/Git/index/build operation. Live UI acceptance remains ROOT-owned.
supersedes: Prior proof logout rule legacy-only-if-chosen was insufficient for pre-existing mixed states; prior bytes are retained as the truthful earlier stage.
